description:
The Mukhyamantri Mukhya Mantri Sewa Yojana for Farmers and Women Self-Help Groups (MMSAYFEWS) is an initiative aimed at supporting farmers and women's self-help groups in India. 

The scheme is designed to enhance the livelihoods of farmers and empower women through self-help groups. 

The objectives include providing financial assistance and promoting sustainable agricultural practices. 

Benefits include access to credit facilities training programs and market linkages for farmers and self-help groups. 

Eligibility criteria typically include being a resident of the respective state and being part of a registered self-help group or a farmer. 

The application process generally involves submitting an application form along with necessary documents to the designated authority. 

The timeline for assistance may vary based on the specific program under the scheme. 

Implementing authorities include the state government departments responsible for agriculture and rural development. 

Additional details may include specific training programs workshops and awareness campaigns conducted under the scheme.
